svg.title: Ontario child care dates from January 2025 to March 2031
svg.desc: Timeline of dated milestones only: the $22-a-day cap from 1 January 2025, the 29 September 2026 announcement, the extension start on 31 March 2027, the $19-a-day average commitment through 30 June 2027, and the extension end on 31 March 2031. No fee is shown after 30 June 2027.
svg.text: Ontario child care dates, 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Mar 2031
Milestones from ontario.ca and the 29 Sep 2026 release. No later fee is plotted.

g.text: $22-a-day cap takes effect for enrolled programs
Children aged 0 to 5. Provincial average described as $19 a day.
Release figure: nearly $12 billion in federal funding over four years.
Commitment to hold a $19-a-day average runs until this date
The release does not set a fee after this date.
